trace.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WHERE o.name <> 'Herb Simon' OR CAST(t.championships AS INT64) = 3
RETURN DISTINCT o.name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.championships AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
